title: HSBC Reiterates “$205.00” Price Target for Apple (AAPL)
text:
HSBC Reiterates “$205.00” Price Target for Apple (AAPL) Posted by Donna Armstrong | Aug 31st, 2018
HSBC set a $205.00 price objective on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a report issued on Thursday morning. The firm currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
Several other research firms also recently commented on AAPL. Atlantic Securities restated a neutral rating and issued a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, May 2nd. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Wednesday, June 13th. Royal Bank of Canada restated a buy rating and issued a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, July 9th. Citigroup boosted their price target on shares of Apple from $100.00 to $142.20 and gave the stock a focus list rating in a research note on Wednesday, May 2nd. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein restated a neutral rating and issued a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, June 25th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple presently has an average rating of Buy and an average target price of $221.00. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL traded up $2.77 during trading on Thursday, hitting $227.80. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 1,075,206 shares, compared to its average volume of 29,046,308. The company has a market cap of $1,079.86 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.84, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.71 and a beta of 1.16. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $149.16 and a fifty-two week high of $228.26.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm posted $1.67 earnings per share. analysts expect that Apple will post 11.68 EPS for the current year.
The firm also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th. Stockholders of record on Monday, August 13th were issued a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date was Friday, August 10th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.28%. Apple’s payout ratio is 31.70%.
In other news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, June 8th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.94, for a total value of $2,988,783.82. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now directly owns 147,819 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $28,224,559.86. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this link . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 400,621 shares of company stock valued at $85,281,642 over the last ninety days. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
Several institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Exane Derivatives acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter worth about $752,000. PGGM Investments grew its position in Apple by 9.6% during the fourth quarter. PGGM Investments now owns 2,305,200 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $390,109,000 after buying an additional 202,386 shares during the period. Epstein & White Financial LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the fourth quarter worth about $969,000. Lenox Wealth Advisors Inc. grew its position in Apple by 47.7% during the fourth quarter. Lenox Wealth Advisors Inc. now owns 6,795 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,150,000 after buying an additional 2,193 shares during the period. Finally, GFS Private Wealth LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the fourth quarter worth about $616,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.61% of the company’s stock.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
